How to play

Drop in turns

You and the AI take turns dropping a space stone into one shared tub. The stack you build is also the space your opponent plays in.

Merge to score

When two stones of the same stage touch, they merge into the next stage, from dust up to a sun. The player who causes a merge scores it.

Do not overflow

If the tub overflows, the player who placed the last stone loses. Think about what you leave behind.

Every opponent plays differently

You always play against an AI opponent, and each one has its own habits, so the same tub plays out differently every time.
